listing.name: Doom 3: Resurrection of Evil (classic) (DUDE — Doom 3 Unified Development Engine)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Published Linux x86_64 tar.gz and Windows x64 ZIP; optional baked-AO ZIP. Limits: Maintained Doom 3 fork with v0.9.6 path-tracing release; renderer hardware requirements differ. Classic edition only. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP and Linux x86-64 tar.gz; native GL/Vulkan renderer requirements differ by mode. Original data: Own original classic Doom3 base/*.pk4 files and Resurrection of Evil d3xp/*.pk4 expansion files. Doom3 BFG Edition files are unsupported. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
